description: This file defines a React functional component, CreateKey, which provides a user interface for creating and managing API keys within a team context. It includes various form sections for key ownership, details, optional settings, guardrails, agent and MCP configurations, model aliases, key lifecycle, and advanced settings. The component interacts with several external services via API calls, supports nested components like dropdowns and selectors, manages complex state, and handles form submission logic for key creation.

methods.name: fetchTeamModels
methods.description: Fetches available models for a specified team and user context, returning a list of model IDs.

methods.name: fetchUserModels
methods.description: Fetches models available to a user and updates state with the list.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles the form submission to create a new API key, including validation, API calls, and state updates.

methods.name: handleCopy
methods.description: Handles copying the generated API key to clipboard with user notification.

methods.name: fetchMcpAccessGroups
methods.description: Fetches MCP access groups and updates state.

methods.name: fetchPossibleRoles
methods.description: Fetches and caches possible user roles for form display.

methods.name: handleUserCreated
methods.description: Callback invoked after creating a new user, updates form and state accordingly.

methods.name: fetchUsers
methods.description: Performs user search based on search input, updates options with search results.

methods.name: handleUserSearch
methods.description: Debounced handler for user search input.

methods.name: handleUserSelect
methods.description: Handles selection of a user from search results, updates form.
